1$0000270("$ 310)༄༅// bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad pas/ dus gcig gi tshe 'od tshogs kyi dbus na rin po che'i khri gcig gi /steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can bzang po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang sems gnyis g.yas g.yon tu gnas pa mngon sum du gzigs te/ gtso bo'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ khams gsum la zhen na nges 'byung min// bdag don la zhen na byang sems min// 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ zhes gsungs pa'i don la dpyad pas// pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi nyams len thams cad zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba'i blo sbyong du 'du bar dgongs te/ chos thams cad la nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no/ sa māsta mi thi// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral bzhugs so// bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*// thugs rje can gyi yi dam lha/ snying nas skyabs su mchi lags kyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos min gyi spyod pa dgos rgyu med// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa la// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag 'tshal// de khyed kyi snyan du gsol ba bgyi// mchod brjod dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba bstan no// tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min// (311)'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min// bdag don la zhen na byang sems min// 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min// dang po tshe 'dir ma zhen pa// tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom pa gsum// tshe 'di la dmigs nas bsgrub pa de// chos pa min gyi bshol la zhog /thog mar tshul khrims bshad rtsa na// mtho ris bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// thar pa bsgrub pa'i thim skas can// sdug bsngal spong ba'i gnyen po can// tshul khrims la med thabs mi 'dug ste// tshe 'di la zhen pa'i tshul khrims de// chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// tshul khrims ngan la gshe ba can// tshul khrims ldan la phrag dog can// rang gi tshul khrims ngo phag can// ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i sa bon can// bcos ma'i tshul khrims bshol la zhog

/thos bsam byed pa'i gang zag de// shes bya bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me can// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lam rgyus can// chos kyi sku yi sa bon can// thos bsam la med thabs mi gda' ste// tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam de// nga rgyal bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can// thos bsam dman la brnyas pa can// thos bsam ldan la phrag dog can// 'khor dang longs spyod 'tshol ba can// ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// chos brgyad kyi thos bsam bshol la zhog /sgom (312)pa bgyid pa'i gang zag kun/ nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po can// thar lam bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon can// sgom pa la med thabs mi 'dug ste// tshe 'di la dmigs pa'i bsgom pa de// dben par bsdad kyang 'du 'dzi can// long gtam smra ba'i kha ton can// thos bsam byed la bskur pa can// sgom pa gzhan la phrag dog can// rang gi sgom pa rnam g.yengs can// chos brgyad kyi bsam gtan bshol la zhog / 'di yan chad kyis/ mngon pa mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes gsungs pa'i don la yang dag dang ltar snang gi dbye ba dngos su bstan no// dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtags pa bsgom tshul shugs la bstan no// mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la/ khams gsum gyi zhen pa spong yang 'tshal/ khams gsum gyi zhen pa spong ba la// 'khor ba'i nyes pa dran par 'tshal// dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin// de legs par bsam na skyi sha 'bung*// thog tu babs na sran thabs med// spong ba'i dge ba mi bsgrub par// ngan song gi so nam byed byed pa// de gang na 'dug kyang the le le// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tsa na// mtho ris ngan 'gror 'gro ba yod// brgya byin tha mal tu skye ba yod// nyi zla mun par 'gro ba yod// bsgyur rgyal bran tu skye ba yod// de lung la bstan nas yid ches kyang*// phal pas rtogs par mi nus pas// rang snang mi yi 'gyur ba ltos// mi phyug po sprang por 'gro yin 'dug kha drag po zhen por 'gro yin 'dug

/mi mang po gcig tu 'gro yin 'dug /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab// 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam tsa na// bya ba'i las la zin pa med// mi mang yang sdug la nyung yang (313)sdug /nor phyug kyang sdug ste ltog kyang sdug /mi tshe thams cad grabs la zad// grabs byed pa'i 'phro la thams cad 'chi// shi yang grabs la zin pa med// tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi mgo la 'ju// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po la// zhen par byed rnams the le le/ 'di yan chad kyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dngos su bstan nas/ las 'bras kyi blang dor shugs la bstan no// mchan/ zhen pa bral na mya ngan 'das// mya ngan 'da' na bde ba thob// zhen pa bzhi bral nyams kyi dbyangs// bdag gcig pur thar bas phan rgyu med/ khams gsum sems can pha ma yin// pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde bar 'dod pa the le le/ khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag gi bsod nams thams cad sems can khyer// bsod nams 'di yis byin rlabs kyis// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas shog / 'di yan chad kyis rgyu byams pas snying rje bsgoms pa shugs la bstan nas/ 'bras bu bdag gzhan brje ba dngos su bstan no/ mchan/ bdag ji ltar 'dod kyang chos nyid kyi ngang*// 'dzin dang bcas la grol ba med// de yang zhib tu bshad tsa na// yod pa 'dzin la thar pa med// med par 'dzin la mtho ris med// gnyis kar 'dzin pa mi shes pas// gnyis med kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /'di yan chad kyis rtag chad kyi lta ba spangs nas zung 'jug gnyis med la blo 'jog tshul spyir bstan no/ mchan/ chos kun sems kyi spyod yul yin// phywa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa// 'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma tshol bar// sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /'di yan chad kyis byang sems sems tsam ba dang thun mong ba'i lam rim bstan nas theg chen dbu ma pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ni/

mchan/ snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin// gnas lugs brjod par mi shes kyis// (314)brjod bral gyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /zhen pa bzhi bral bshad pa yis// 'di yan chad kyis zhi gnas bsgom tshul shugs la bstan nas/ lhag mthong bsgom tshul la yul snang sems su bsgrub pa dang*/ de rang bzhin med pa/ rten 'brel dang*/ brjod bral du gtan la phab nas/ spros bral zung 'jug bsgom pa dngos su bstan no// mchan/ dge ba 'di yi bsod nams kyis// 'gro ba bdun po ma lus pa// sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par shog / 'di bsngo bas 'bras bu bstan no// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag go /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang 'phrad// bcos ma ma yin pa'i blo skyes nas dam chos phyin ci ma log pa cig byed dgos/ de la zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba cig nyams su len dgos/ de gang zhe na/ tshe 'di la ma zhen pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba la ma zhen pa/ bdag gi don la ma zhen pa/ dngos po dang mtshan ma la ma zhen pa'o// de bshad na tshe 'di chu'i chu bur dang 'dra bas nam 'chi nges pa med pas zhen pa byung ring mi chog /khams gsum 'khor ba 'di dag dug gi 'bras bu dang 'dra bas/ 'phral zhim yang phugs su gnod pa skyel/ su zhen pa byed pa tsho 'khrul/ rang gi don la zhen na dgra'i bu gsos ba dang 'dra/ 'phral dga' dga' ltar byed kyang*/ phugs su rang la gnod pa skyel nges/ des na rang don la zhen na'ang 'phral bde yang*/ phugs ngan song du 'gro'o// dngos po dang mtshan ma la mngon par zhen na/ smrig rgyu la chur 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ 'phral chur snang yang btung rgyu med/ 'khor ba 'di blo 'khrul pa la snang yang*/

shes rab kyis brtags na ngo bo grub pa ci yang med/ des na 'das pa la sems ma bzhugs ma 'ongs pa la sems mi gzhug /da ltar ba la rnam par shes pa mi gzhug pa cig go bar byas nas/ chos thams cad spros bral du shes par bya'o// de ltar byas pas tshe 'di nyid la ma zhan pas ngan song du mi skye/ khams gsum 'khor ba la ma zhen pas 'khor bar mi skye/ bdag gi don la ma zhen pas (315)nyan rang du mi skye/ dngos po dang mtshan ma la ma zhen pas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya'o// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa dpal sa skya pa chen po'i lugs kyi dgongs pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ rje btsun chen po sa skya pa'i zhal nas/ mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba chen po mchog don tu gnyer bar 'dod pa rnams kyis/ zhen pa bzhi dang bral dgos te/ de la zhen pa bzhi ni/ tshe 'di la zhen pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba la zhen pa/ bdag gi don la zhen pa/ dngos po dang mtshan ma la zhen pa'o// de'i gnyen po'ang bzhi ste/ zhen pa dang po'i gnyen por 'chi ba mi rtag par bsgom pa/ gnyis pa'i gnyen por 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa/ gsum pa'i gnyen por byang chub kyi sems dran pa/ bzhi pa'i gnyen por chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bdag med par dran pa'o// de ltar dran zhing goms par byas pa'i 'bras bu bzhi 'byung ste/ chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba/ de ltar shes shing goms pa'i 'bras bu/ 'khrul snang gnas gyur ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ngo// de la dang por tshe 'di la zhen pa'i gnyen po 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pa ni/ nam 'chi cha med par bsam/ 'chi rkyen mang bar bsam/ 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan par rgyas par bsam mo/ de ltar bsam pa gcig skyes nas/

snying nas chos gcig byed 'dod 'ong ste/ de'i dus na chos chos su 'gro ba yin no// de nas khams gsum 'khor ba la zhen pa'i gnyen por 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa ni/ de ltar tshe 'di la zhen pa la nyes pa de ltar 'dug kyang*/ gzhan 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin la sogs pa kun bde ba mchog yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ de rnams kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang (316)bzhin las ma 'das pa ste/ de rnams kyi tshe dang longs spyod bskal pa du mar gnas shing rgyas kyang mthar 'chi zhing 'jig ste/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar skye ba'i nyen yod pas na/ de thams cad kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das snyam du bsam zhing*/ goms pa na chos lam du 'gro ba cig yod de/ khams gsum sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das par 'dug pas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba cig rang dgos snyam pa'i blo skye zhing*/ lam thams cad de'i don tu bsgrub pa cig 'ong ngo*// de ltar rgyud la skyes kyang byang chub kyi sems dang mi ldan pa'i bdag gcig pu bde ba don du gnyer na/ dgra bcom pa'am rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur bas na/ bdag gi don la zhen pa'i gnyen por byang chub kyi sems dran pa ni/ de ltar khams gsum sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'di las bdag gcig pu grol bas mi phan te/ sems can 'di rnams re re nas bdag gi pha dang ma ma byas pa med pas/ 'di rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba mchog thob na bdag bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du dmyal ba'i sems can tu skyes kyang sla'i snyam pa'i blo goms shing skyes tsam na/ lam gyi 'khrul ba dang po bdag gi don la zhen pa sel ba yin no// de ltar skyes shing goms kyang bden 'dzin dang bcas par gyur na thams cad mkhyen pa mi thob pas/ dngos po dang mtshan mar zhen pa'i gnyen por chos thams cad bdag med par dran dgos te/ der yang chos thams cad cir yang ma grub pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la/

bden 'dzin byung na rtag lta yin la/ stong par zhen pa chad lta yin la/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur yid la bya'o// de yang bdag gi rmi lam dang snang ba bsres shing bsgom pas rmi lam mi bden pa bzhin tu snang ba yang mi bden bzhin tu snang ba yin snyam du yang yang dran zhing bsgom pa na/ lam gyi 'khrul pa gnyis pa/(317)dngos po dang mtshan mar zhen pa sel ba yin no// de ltar 'khrul pa thams cad bsal zhing mthar phyin pa na/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba zhes bya ba 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes la sogs pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bde ba'i mchog 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsungs zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa*/ maṅga laṃ/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid yig rje bla ma ā nan+da bhadra'i gsung bsgros bzhugs so// bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'o sems can thams cad kyi don tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan la de'i don nyams su blang snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa chos nyan pa'i kun spyod rnams gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo mdo sde thams cad kyi nyams len gyi gnad phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi man ngag nyams su len pa la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun bar byed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ gdams ngag dngos po gnyis so// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pa chen po// dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i dus/ snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba bla mar bsten te chos gsan pas/ bla ma'i gsung gis khyod pha jo sras tsam gyi bu yin pas slob gnyer byed dgos shing*/

de la shes rab dgos pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bsgrub pa gyis gsung nas 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang dang lung gnang zhing*/ bla mas kyang bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad nas/ bla brang rnying mar bsgrub pa mdzad pas/ bar chad kyi cho 'phrul cung zad byung (318)ba la/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ chu bsrung gi sgo nas bzlog pa mdzad cing*/ zla ba drug bsgrubs pas dus gcig gi tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ rin po che'i khri'i steng na chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' gnyis dang bcas pa mngon sum du zhal gzigs te/ de'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min// 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min// bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ zhes pa'i tshig dang bzhi po 'di gsungs/ de'i don la thugs bsam mdzad pas/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung mdo sde thams cad kyi nyams len 'dir 'dus shing zab par dgongs nas thugs nyams su bzhes so// des slob dpon rin po che la gnang*/ des rje btsun rin po che la/ des chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la/ des 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa la// des zhang dkon mchog dpal ba la/ des rgyal ba brag phug pa la/ des chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ des bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ des chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ des bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa kun dga' bzang po la gnang ngo*// gnyis pa man ngag dgos la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi dang po la gnyis las/ skyabs 'gro ni theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro khyad par bzhi ldan te/ de'ang skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ yon tan gyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ skyon gyi rnam pa gang yang med pa'i gang zag zla med pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog /de'ang byang sems phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i chos ji lta ba dang*/

ji snyed pa chos dkon mchog /de dag tshul bzhin tu bsgrub pa'i byang (319)sems phyir mi ldog pa dge 'dun dkon mchog ste de la skyabs su 'gro// dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du gang zag bdag gcig pu skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin gyi/ pha mas thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ ched du bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod nas skyabs su 'gro bas de'i don dran cing ma yengs pa'i sgo nas ngag tu/ bdag gzhan mar gyur nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// rgyal sras 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ dkon mchog rin po che rnams pa gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag gi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos lam du 'gro bar= lam 'khrul pa sel bar= 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar= blo la chos ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo la bslab par bgyi'o/ snyam pa 'jug pa ste smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa'i don yid la dran bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/zhes brjod do/ (320)gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ zhes pa'i don tshe 'di la ma zhen pa cig dgos kyi zhen na smig rgyu la chur zhen kyang*/ skom pa sel ba'i don mi byed pa ltar tshul khrims dang thos bsam bsgom gsum ci byas kyang*/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i ched

nyams su len pa la lus rdo rje skyil krung ngam/ ji ltar bde bar byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu song nas/ du song bas chos rnal mar mi 'gro// des na/ dpal mgon dbyig gnyen gyis mngon pa mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes pa ltar gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la brten nas thog mar thos pa bya/ de nas de'i don la bsam nas sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i don la bsgom dgos pas de la'ang chos byed par 'dod pa'i blo ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ chos byed pa la brtson 'grus mchog tu 'gyur ba'i ched du 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i rten tu gyur pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten 'di'ang rnyed par dka' bas/ rnyed pa'i dus 'dir chos rnam dag cig bya dgos snyam du yang yang bsgom mo// de nyid cung zad rgyas par bshad na bzhi ste/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba/ grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba/ dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ dal 'byor gyi rten rnam par dag pa thob pa la// rgyu tshul khrims la sogs pa dge ba'i las bsgrub cing*/ mi dge ba mtha' dag (321)spang dgos pa la/ khams gsum gyi sems can dge ba bsgrub pa nyung*/ mi dge ba spyod pa shin tu mang bas/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' snyam du bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ sems can gyi khams la bltas pas dmyal ba ni mang nyung sa'i rdul tsam/ yi dwags ni kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa'i grangs tsam/ dud 'gro ni chang dar ma'i sbangs ma tsam du mang la/

de rnams la ltos na mi'i lus rnam par dag pa thob pa ches nyung bas/ grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' snyam du bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ de nyid phyir na bcom ldan gyis// rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi /bu gar ru sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi nyid shin tu rnyed dka' gsungs// zhes gsungs pas/ rgya mtsho chen po na gnas pa'i ru sbal zhar ba lo brgya nas lan re steng du 'ongs pa dang*/ gser gyi gnya' shing bu ga gcig brgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis g.yengs pas bu gar ru sbal gyi mgrin pa chud pa srid pa tsam yin pa ltar/ sems can gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ mir skyes pa yang srid pa tsam yin pas/ dpe'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka' snyam du bsgom mo// bzhi pa ni/ lkugs pa dang kla klor skyes pa sogs mi khom pa brgyad dang bral zhing*/ 'byor pa bcu tshangs bar skye ba dkon pas ngo bo'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka' snyam du bsgom mo// gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ slob dpon dpa' bos mya ngan bsal ba las/ 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi// mdun na gnas pa 'chi ba ste/ zhes bshad pas/ skyes pa'i tha mar nges par 'chi bas de yang cung zad bshad na/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang*// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong dang*// lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// zhes pa ltar mi (322)khom pa brgyad spongs shing*/ 'byor ba bcu ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ ces pa rang 'byor lnga dang*/ ston pa byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o// zhes pa ltar gzhan 'byor lnga ste 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rnyed par dka' ba rang gzhan gyi blo gros dang bstun te bshad par bya'o// myur du chos byed dgos snyam du bsgom// de nyid cung zad bshad na// nges par 'chi ba bsam pa/

nam 'chi nges pa med pa bsam pa/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos las gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pa bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i chos nyid yin pas/ mthar 'jig dgos te/ mdo rgya che rol pa las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs// skye bu'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog bzhin te// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin tu myur mgyogs 'gro /zhes gsungs shing*/ khyad par du/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i// rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na// chu bur lus lta smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston na/ so so'i skye bo rnams nges par 'chi dgos snyam du bsam zhing*/ slob dpon dba' bos/ drang srong chen po lnga mngon shes// mkha' la thog med rgyu bas kyang*/ gang na 'chi med spyod yul ba'i// gnas der phyin pa ma yin no// zhes bshad pas/ khams gsum gang du skyes kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i gnas med pas nges par 'chi dgos snyam du bsgom mo// 'chi ba'i rkyen mang zhing 'tsho ba'i rkyen nyung ba'i sgo nas kyang nges par 'chi ste/ slob (323)dpon klu sgrub kyis rin chen phreng ba las// 'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang*// 'tsho ba'i rkyen ni nyung zad tsam// de dag nyid kyang 'chi rkyen te// de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs pas 'tsho ba'i rkyen tu 'dod pa'i gnas dang*/ zas dang longs spyod la sogs pa 'ga' zhig kyang 'chi rkyen tu 'gyur ba yod pas nges par 'chi snyam du bsgom mo// gnyis pa nam 'chi cha med bsam pa ni/ la la ma'i mngal du 'chi ba nas/ la la skyes ma thag 'chi ba sogs rgan gzhon bar ma nges pa med par 'chi ba mngon sum gyis mngon pas/ nam 'chi nges pa med pa'i tshul bsam zhing bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/

de ltar 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na/ kha drag cing dbang btsan pa dang*/ 'khor dang longs spyod che ba dang*/ dpa' ba la sogs pa gang gi'ang mi bzlog par nges par 'chi dgos la/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma yin pa gang gi'ang mi phan/ de la tshe ji srid gnas kyi bar du chos byas pas 'chi ba'i tshe mi 'gyod/ 'gro ba bzang por skye ba'i gdengs thob pas blo bde/ des na nges par dam pa'i chos bya dgos la/ de'ang nam 'chi nges pa med pas myur du chos bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ zhes pa'i don khams gsum 'khor ba la zhen na/ chos byas kyang byang chub kyi lam du mi 'gro bas/ 'khor ba la ma zhen pa cig dgos/ de la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad pas 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin tu mthong nas de spang bar 'dod cing thar pa don tu gnyer ba'i blo 'byung bas de'i rtogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad pa dang*/ 'khor bar skye ba'ang las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor ma shes par mi dge ba bag yangs su spyad pa las byung bas// rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor shes par bya ba'i phyir las rgyu 'bras bsam pa dang gnyis so// (324)dang po ni/ mdo las/ 'dod pa'i khams ni skyon dang bcas pa ste// de bzhin gzugs kyi khams kyang skyon dang bcas// gzugs med khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa ste// mya ngan 'das pa 'ba' zhig skyon med mthong*// zhes gsungs pas gnas khams gsum po gang du skyes kyang skyon dang bcas pa yin la// de'i tshul rgyas par mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha rnams bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam yang*// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ zhes gsungs pas gnas khams gsum po der/ 'gro ba rigs drug po gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can/

gang la longs spyod kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod can 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pas de las thar bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi lam du 'gro ba'i chos rnam par dag pa bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo// de nyid cung zad bshad na/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ yi dwags gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang gsum mo// dang po la/ grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ nyi tshe nyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang gsum/ dang po la brgyad de/ chu bur can ni nyi ma dang 'jo skyibs la sogs pa med pa'i gangs ri'i bar dang*/ chab ram la sogs pa'i nang du skyes/ rlung shin tu grang bas lus la btab pas grang ba'i rkyen gyis lus thams cad chu bur gyi rang bzhin can tu song ba dang*/ tshe'i tshad kyang mdzod las/ til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhig /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe (325)yi tshad// gzhan gyi tshe tshad nyis 'gyur yin// zhes gsungs so// de las kyang grang ba'i rkyen gyis chu bur brdol te/ chu ser dang rnag khrag la sogs pa 'dzag pa chu bur rdol ba can dang*/ de las kyang grang ba'i rkyen gyis shin tu sdug bsngal te/ a cu zer ba'i dung mo'i sgra lhang lhang 'don pa a cu zer ba dang*/ de las kyang grang ba'i rkyen gyis sdug bsngal zhing skad cher 'don pa'i nus pa med par lkog ma nas kyi hud kyi hud ces pa'i sgra shib shib 'don pa kyi hud zer ba dang*/ de las cher grang ba'i rkyen gyis skad che chung gang yang 'don pa'i mthu med par lus thams cad shin tu 'khyag ste 'tham pa'i rnam pa can du byas pa so tham tham pa dang*/ de las kyang ches grang zhing stobs che ba'i rlung gis btab pas pags pa'i mdog sngon por gyur cing dum bu brgyad la sogs par gas pa ut+pal ltar gas pa dang*/

pags pa'i mdog sngon por gyur pa de'ang rul zhing rlung gis btab pas shus te lus dmar por song zhing*/ dum bu mang por gas pa pad+ma ltar gas pa dang*/ yang grang ba'i rkyen gyis shin tu 'khyags te/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad rdo lta bu'i dngos por gyur cing dum bu bcu drug la sogs par gas te phyi'i lus gas pa'i dbang gis rgyu ma dang*/ mnye ma dang*/ long ka la sogs pa'ang tshal pa tshal par gas pa pad+ma ltar cher gas pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal dran par byas nas yang yang bsam mo// gnyis pa la'ang brgyad de/ yang sos zhes bya ba/ las kyi dbang gis lcags sregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng du skyes/ lus shin tu gzhon sha can bdag tu 'dzin pa che ba lag tu gang blangs pa thams cad mtshon char 'gro ba/ skyes bu phan tshun mthong ba thams cad dgra'i 'du shes can/ de rnams phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mtshon gyis bsnun cing gtubs pas lus dum bu dum bur gyur pa dang*/ nam mkha' nas yang sos par gyur cig ces bya (326)ba'i sgra dang*/ rlung grang mo gcig gis lus la btab pas snga ma bzhin tu gzhon sha can la sogs par gyur pa'o// thig nag ces bya ba/ lus la dmyal srung rnams kyis thig brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa btab nas sog les gshags pa dang sta re la sogs pas gzhog cing sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myang ba'o// bsdus 'joms zhes bya ba lus shin tu gnon sha can ri ra dang lug la sogs pa'i mgo bo can gyi bar du btsir te shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o/ ngu 'bod ces bya ba lcags sregs kyi sa gzhir/ dmyal srung ba rnams kyis ded cing bros pas khang pa dkar po gcig mthong ste/ 'dir bros pas thub snyam du nang du phyin pa na/ khang pa sgo rang 'grig tu gyur pa dang lcags bsregs kyi khang par gyur te/ brkos pas phyed pa'i phyir thar ba'i skabs med pa dang*/ me rang 'bar du gyur te/ shin tu sdug bsngal shing dud mo'i sgra 'byin pa'o/

ngu 'bod chen po ni mtshan nyid snga ma bzhin las/ khang pa gnyis rims so// tsha ba ni/ dmyal bsrungs rnams kyis lcags bsregs kyi mdung rtse gcig pas gshang lam nas spyi gtsug gi bar du thal byung du phug ste sdug bsngal ba'o// rab tu tsha ba ni/ mdung rtse gsum pas gshang lam nas spyi gtsug gi bar dang*/ 'phang tshos g.yas g.yon nas dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi bar thal byung du phug ste sdug bsngal ba'o// mnar med pa ni lcags sregs kyi sa gzhir mes bsregs shing me 'di yin lus 'di yin zhes tha dad du dbyer med par gyur cing bsregs nas/ dud mo'i sgra las dpags te/ 'di na sems can dmyal ba cig 'dug go snyam du mtshon pa'o// de rnams kyi tshe'i tshad ni mdzod las/ mi rnams lo ni lnga bcu la// 'dod lha dag gis lha rnams las// 'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /de na rang lo lnga brgya'o// gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro// yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// (327)zhes gsungs te/ mi lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i zhag gcig byas/ de sum cu la zla ba gcig /de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya ni rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i tshe tshad yin zhing*/ de nyid zhag gcig tu rtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya yang sos pa'i tshe tshad do// de bzhin tu mi lo brgya la zhag gcig byas pa'i rang lo stong sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshe tshad yin zhing*/ de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo stong thig nag pa'i tshe tshad do// mi lo nyis brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo nyis stong mtha' bral ba'i tshe tshad/ de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo nyis stong bsdus 'joms pa'i tshe tshad do// mi lo bzhi brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo bzhi stong dga' ldan pa'i tshe tshad do// de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo bzhi stong ngu 'bod chen po pa'i tshe tshad do// mi lo brgyad brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo brgyad stong 'phrul dga' ba'i tshe tshad/

de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod chen po ba'i tshe tshad do// mi lo stong drug brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i tshe tshad/ de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong tsha ba pa'i tshe tshad do// rab tu tsha ba bas bar skal phyed dang*/ mnar med pas bar bskal gcig thub bo// gsum pa la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ me ma mur gyi 'obs ni/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba thams cad kyi mtha' na yod de/ de'ang 'obs kyi nang me ma mur gyi gang ba der tshud de/ yan lag thams cad tshig cing rkang pa g.yas btegs na tshig pa sos shing g.yon pa tshig /g.yon pa btegs pa na de sos shing g.yas pa tshig /nang gi rgyu ma dang mnyer ma la sogs pa'ang tshig cing dbang po'i sgo rnams nas du ba 'thul ba'o// gnyis pa ro myags kyi 'dam ni/ phyi sa la sogs pa mi gtsang ba'i dngos po mtha' dag nur nur bor yod pa'i nang du/ gan rkyal dang khas bub la sogs par 'gyel zhing (328)dbang po'i sgo thams cad mi gtsang ba'i dngos pos gang bar bsam nas sdug bsngal zhing*/ de'i gseb na lcags kyi mchu can gyi 'bu srin la sogs pas lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag thams cad rus pa la thug gi bar du 'bigs shing gcod par byed pas shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o// gsum pa spu gri'i lam ni/ ro myags kyi 'dam las 'das pa na/ spu gris gtams pa'i thang shin tu rno ba'i steng du phyin nas rkang pa'i sha dang rus pa la thug gi bar du gtub cing sdug bsngal ba'o// sogs khongs nas ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal zhes bya ba/ shing sdong gi yal ga thams cad ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon char yod pa la/ las kyi dbang gis tsha bas nyen nas skyabs tshol ba'i phyir de'i 'khris su bsdad pa dang*/ de rlung gis bskyod nas mtshon char rnams kyis yan lag thams cad dum bur gtub cing shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o// shal ma ri'i sdong po ni/

ri shin tu mtho ba'i rtse mor phyin na snyam nas 'dzegs pa dang*/ lcags kyi thur ma sor brgyad pa dang*/ bcu drug pa thur du bstan pas lus thal byung du phug cing sdug bsngal la/ ri'i rtse mor phyin pa dang*/ khwa ta dang 'ol ba la sogs pas mig 'bru lce 'don/ klad pa la sogs pa 'dru zhing sdug bsngal/ yang ri'i rtsa bar sleb na snyam nas mthur la phyin pa na/ lcags kyi thur ma rnams kha gyen la bstan nas lus 'bigs shing*/ ri'i rtsa ba na yod pa'i lcags kyi spyang ku dang*/ khyi dang wa la sogs pas yan lag rnams za zhing phan tshun tu 'then pas lus dum bur chad cing sdug bsngal ba'o// gzhan yang lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhir lus phur pas brgyangs pa dang*/ lce lcags phur gyis brgyangs nas rmo ba la sogs pas sdug bsngal ba'ang nyi tshe nyi 'khor ba'i nang tshan yin no// bzhi pa thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med ni/ spu gri'i thang gi pha rol na thal tshan gyis chus lus g.yengs nas lus kyi phyi nang kun tshig cing*/ dmyal bsrung gis mtha' nas bsrungs te (329)sdug bsngal ba'o// de rnams kyi sdug bsngal bsam zhing de las thar pa'i dam pa'i chos bya dgos snyam du yang yang bsam zhing bsgom mo// gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can nam/ sgrib pa can gyi sgrib pa can zhes pa gsum mo// dang po ni/ ser sna la sogs pa mi dge ba'i dbang gis yi dwags kyis rgyal khams su skyes nas/ bkres pa dang skom pas nyam thag kyang zas skom mig gi'ang mi mthong ngo*/ rgyang ring po nas 'bras zan la sogs pa'i ri dang*/ chu'i rgyal khams chen por 'dug snyam nas phyin pa dang*/ shin tu thag ring zhing bgrod dka' bas lus sems sdug bsngal/ der phyin pa dang 'bras zan gyi rir snang ba de/ rdo dkar po'am/ sa dkar po'i phung por song*/ sngar chu'i rgyal khams su snang ba de yang smig rgyu'am/

sa sngon nam/ g.yam pa sngon po la sogs pa'i dngos por gyur te/ bza' btung longs spyod rgyu med pas kyang ches sdug bsngal ba'o// nang gi sgrib pa can ni sngar gyi sdug bsngal de'i steng du yang zas skom cung zad zos pas dang por kha khab mig tsam du dog pas mi chud nas kha ral cing khrag 'dzag ste sdug bsngal/ de nas mgrin pra rta rnga tsam du 'phra ba la ma chud cing*/ kha zas kyang rtsub pa'i reg bya can tu gyur pas mgrin pa ral te tsha bas sdug bsngal/ de nas lto ba ri'i ltos tsam du cung zad slebs kyang 'grangs pa'am/ skom pa sel ba'i nus pa med pas slar yang sdug bsngal ba'o// zas skom gyi sgrib pa can/ kha zas tshol ba'i phyir phyogs kun tu phyin pa na/ yi dwags kyi ded dpon gzhan gyis ded cing brdungs shing 'jigs pas sdug bsngal/ kha zas cung zad rnyed pa gzhan gyis phrogs su dogs pa dang*/ cung zad rnyed pa de zos pas sngar bzhin tu kha la ma chud pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal zhing*/ lto bar sleb pa na las (330)kyis dbang gis kha zas de me 'bar nas/ rgyu ma dang gnye ma la sogs kun tshig cing gzhob gyi dngos por byas te/ la la sogs pa dbang po'i sgo rnams nas me 'bar bas sdug bsngal ba'o// de ltar shin tu sdug bsngal yang*/ las de ma zad kyi bar du sdug bsngal drag po myong dgos pa 'dug /'di lta bu mi skye ba'i phyir byang chub kyi lam du 'gro ba'i chos rnam dag gcig bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo// gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ bying na gnas pa dang*/ kha 'thor ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang na chu srin la sogs pa'i srog chags chang ngar ma'i sbangs ma tsam yod pas/ gcig gis gcig btsir te dog sa'i sdug bsngal/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis phyogs mtha' dag tu ded pas gnas ma nges pa dang*/ grogs su dang 'phrad/ su dang 'grogs ma nges pa bag phebs rgyu med pa dang*/

che bas chung ba za ba dang*/ chu srin la sogs pa che ba rnams kyi lus dung la sogs pas 'bigs pas sdug bsngal ba dang*/ yang gling bar gyi mun pa na yod pa rnams snang ba'i dngos po dang bral bas gcig gis gcig mthong rgyu med pa dang*/ gcig gis steng gcig bsdad de dog cing lji ba dang*/ shin tu dog cing btsir bas lus dub cing chad pa dang*/ zas skom tshol ba'i skabs tsam yang med pas sdug bsngal ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ mi la brten pa'i dud 'gro rnams ni/ mi theg pa'i khal bkal ba dang*/ rmo ba dang*/ bzho ba dang*/ lcags sgrog gis bcing ba dang*/ lcag dang lcag kyus btab pa dang*/ las kyi mtha' sna tshogs kyi sgo nas longs spyod/ mthar sha'i ched du gsod pa dang*/ gzhan la btsong ste skyugs pa dang*/ mi rtag bal dang rus pa dang pags pa'i ched du gsod pas sdug bsngal ba'o// mi la ma brten pa'i ri dwags sogs ni gnas la nges pa med cing*/ sha'i ched du rngon pas mda' bsnun cing khyis brdas te ngom grogs dang (331)g.yang sa la sogs par mchongs pa dang*/ mtshon gyis btab bzhin tu bros kyang mthar zin te bsad pa sogs sdug bsngal lo snyam du bsam/ dud 'gro spyi'i sdug bsngal glen lkugs dang*/ bye brag gi sdug bsngal ba bsam ste chos rnam par dag pa cig bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo// gnyis pa 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ lha lta bu sngon gyi las kyi stobs kyis khang bzang dang*/ gos dang kha zas la sogs pa bsam pa tsam gyis 'byung ba dang*/ lha mo'i bde ba la sogs pa mtha' yas kyang*/ 'chi ltas lnga dang*/ nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga la sogs pa phog pa na/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las kyang che ba'i yid kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ shi nas kyang brgya byin lta bu'i gtso bor gyur pa yang mi'i nang du bran la sogs par skye ba dang*/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu rang gi khang pa'i 'od kyis gling bzhi gsal bar nus pa yang gling bar gyi mun par skyes te/

rang gi lag pa brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong bas sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid du gyur kyang*/ mthar 'khor ba'i yang bran tu 'gyur pa dang*/ mi lta bu kha drag po zhan por 'gro ba dang*/ phyug po dbul por 'gro ba dang*/ mi mang po yod kyang mthar rabs chad pa dang*/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad pa'am phrad kyis dog pa dang*/ gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba'am bral gyis dog pa dang*/ 'dod pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa dang*/ re ba 'bras bu med pa la sogs pas sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab bo// lha ma yin rnams kyang phan tshun 'thab cing mtshon gyis 'debs pa dang*/ yan lag rnams gtub pa dang rang bzhin gyis zhe sdang che zhing lha'i dpal la phrag dog pas yid kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab bo// gsum pa khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ mi rnams kyi las kyi mtha' bsam gyis mi khyab pas ci tsam byas kyang zin rgyu med pa dang*/ (332)byas pa chud zos pa dang*/ yang 'di dang 'di lta bu byed dgos snyam du mi tshe grangs la zad cing*/ las mthar phyin rgyu med par 'chi ba'i dus byas te/ bsam pa ma rdzogs pas shin tu sdug bsngal zhing*/ nor yod pa rnams rkun mas khyer ba dang*/ dbang btsan pos 'phrog pa la sogs pas sdug bsngal/ dbul po rnams nad tshol ba'i phyir shin tu sha thang chad pas sdug bsngal/ mdor na gnas khams gsum sogs rten rigs drug po gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ 'di'i sdug bsngal mi myong bar bya ba'i phyir chos rnam par dag pa bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo// gnyis pa las rgyu 'bras bsam pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i sdug bsngal can gyi 'khor bar skye ba'ang*/ rgyu mi dge ba spyad pa las byung bas/ de spong ba la de'i rgyu spang dgos shing*/ de'ang mdor bsdus na rgyu mi dge ba mtha' dag spong*/ dge ba sna re tsam yang ci nus kyis bsgrub snyam du bsgom mo// de nyid cung zad rgyas par bshad na/

mi dge ba'i las bsam pa/ dge ba'i las bsam pa/ lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa dang gsum mo// dang po la las kyi ngo bo bsam pa/ de'i 'bras bu bsam pa/ de spong bar gdams pa dang gsum/ dang po la bcu ste/ kun slong dug gsum gang rung gis kun nas bslangs pa'i gsod sems kyis srog chags grog sbur nas mi'am mir chags pa'i bar gang rung bsam bzhin tu bsad pa srog gcod pa dang*/ gzhan gyis bdag gir bzung ba'i rdzas 'bru'i bub ma tsam yang ma byin par len pa dang*/ rang gis rin 'jal te gnyen du 'thams pa'i bud med ma gtogs/ gzhan gyi bud med dang dge tshul ma lta bu chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang*/ nyin gcig pa'i sdom pa bsrung ba dang*/ pha ma la sogs pas bsrung ba dang*/ rang gi bud med yin yang nyin par spyod pa la sogs pa 'dod pas log par g.yem pa ste/ (333)lus kyi mi dge ba gsum dang*/ 'dod chags lta bu'i kun nas bslang ste/ gzhan gyi mgo bskor ba'i phyir 'du shes bsgyur te tshig dang don gzhan gyis go bar smra ba rdzun dang*/ gzhan mdza' ba dbye ba'i phyir pha rol po la dbyen tu 'gyur ba'i gtam smra ba phra ma dang*/ zhe sdang lta bu'i kun nas bslangs te/ don dang mthun mi mthun ji ltar yin yang skad shugs chen pos gzhan gyi sems la gzan par smra ba'i tshig rtsub dang*/ don dang mi mthun pa'i gtam chal chol mang du smra bas rang gzhan gyi dge sbyor sogs kyi bar du gcod cing gtad so med par smra ba ngag 'khyal te/ ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi dang*/ 'dod chags kyis kun nas bslang ste gzhan gyi longs spyod dang dbang phyug la sogs pa bdag gis longs spyod du gyur na snyam du gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa bdag gis thob par 'dod pa brnabs sems dang*/ zhe sdang gis kun nas bslang ste gang zag gzhan 'di la gnod pa cig byas na/ 'di shin tu sdug bsngal na ci ma rung snyam du bsam pa lta bu gnod sems dang*/

gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te/ las rgyu 'bras dang*/ bden bzhi dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa la yod med dang*/ rgyu dge ba la 'bras bu bde ba dang*/ mi dge ba la 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung zhes bla ma dag gsungs yang mi bden nam snyam pa log lta ste/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum dang bcu'o// gnyis pa de'i 'bras bu la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshe thung ba dang*/ longs spyod dbul ba dang*/ rang gi khyim thabs la sogs pas dgra lta bur byed pa dang*/ gzhan gyis bskul pa 'debs pa dang*/ rang gi mdza' bo dang mi mthun par 'gyur ba dang*/ gtam mi snyan pa thos pa dang*/ de'i gtam la byung gnas med ces bden par mi 'dzin pa dang (334)rab 'bras bu med pa dang*/ 'jigs pa chen po dang phrad pa dang*/ lta ba phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ mi dge ba chung ngur spyad pas dud 'gro dang*/ 'bring gis yi dwags dang*/ chen por spyad pas dmyal bar 'phen pa'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te/ mi dge ba de rnams spyad pas 'bras bu ngan song las 'das pa mi 'dug pas ci nas kyang*/ srog la bab rung mi byed par yid kyis dam bca' zhing lus ngag gis spong ba'o// gsum pa dge ba'i las bsam pa la'ang*/ las kyi ngo bo bsam pa/ de'i 'bras bu bsam pa/ de bsgrub par gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i mi dge ba bcu spong zhing*/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pas kun nas bslangs te/ dge ba bcu po ci nus bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa de'i 'bras bu la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis// dang po ni/ tshe ring ba dang*/ longs spyod che ba dang*/ khyim thabs la sogs pas yid dang mthun par byed pa dang*/ phyogs kun tu snyad grags thob pa dang*/ mdza' bo dang mthun par 'gyur ba dang*/

dbang po dwangs pa dang*/ tshig brtsan pa dang*/ yid kyi re ba 'grub pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ lta ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'o// mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ dge ba bcu po chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang chen por spyad pas nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob bo// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dge ba bcu spyad pa las/ 'bras bu byang chub gsum gang rung thob cing*/ nyan thos kyi go 'phang lta bu thob kyang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las grol bar 'dug (335)pas ci nas kyang dag pa bsgrub snyam du bsam mo// gsum pa lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa la gsum las/ dang po las kyi ngo bo ni/ dge mi dge gang gi'ang kun slong med par btang snyoms su kha zas za ba dang*/ bzo byed pa la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de'i 'bras bu'ang bde ba dang sdug bsngal gang yang 'byin mi nus pas/ btang snyoms pa'i gzo byed pa la sogs pa spro ba dang lag tu len pa'o// gsum pa de dge bar bsgyur ba ni/ kun slong gi dbang gis 'gyur ba yin pas/ kha zas za ba lta bu la'ang*/ lus kyi srin bu gso snyam pa dang*/ lus brtas par byas nas thol bsam la sogs pa byed snyam pa dang*/ 'gro 'dug la sogs pa byed na'ang bla ma la mjal ba'i ched dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi ched du 'gro ba dang*/ g.yas phyogs na sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs yod par bsam ste/ de la lus kyi drag shos g.yas bstan nas bskor ba byed par bsam ste 'gro ba lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ zhes pa'i don/ sngar bshad pa ltar 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal tu mthong nas de lta bu la thar pa'i phyir/ dge ba chung 'bring ci rigs su spyad pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob kyang*/ de'ang rang don ma rdzogs shing gzhan don rgya chen po mi nus la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la gegs dang bcas pa yin pas de lta bu'i rang don kho na don tu mi gnyer bar sems can thams cad kyi don tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de yang rgyu rkyen ma tshang ba dang nor ba las mi skye ste/ dper na dgun lta bur drod gsher ma 'dzom pa'i dus 'bras kyi sa bon btab kyang mi skye/ 'bras 'dod pa la nas btab kyang 'bras kyi lo tog mi 'byung gi /'bras (336)kyi lo tog 'dod pa la rgyu 'bras kyi sa bon dang*/ rkyen chu lud drod gsher 'dzom na skye ba ltar rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rgyu snying rje chen po las byung ba yin/ rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems las byung ba yin/ rkyen thabs la mkhas pas mthar phyin par byas pa yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i don nyams su len pa la/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ gnyen la bsgom pa/ bar ma la bsgom pa/ dgra la bsgom pa/ sems can thams cad la bsgom pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum/ mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ de la byams pa bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gi da lta'i ma lta bu la mtshon na/ 'dis da lta ma byas par ma zad/ skye ba mang po'i bar du ma byas pa yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bshes sprin las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam// ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo las/ sems can gcig gis ma byas te// nu zho 'thungs pa gang yin pa// rgya mtsho bzhi la'ang de tsam med// sems can gcig gis pha byas te// rta dang glang po byin pa rnams// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang brgal/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa drin dran pa ni/ ma byas res kyi phan tshad med pa btags te/ de'ang mjal du chags dus zla ba dgu'am bcu yi bar du lus lji ba dang*/ ngal ba dang*/ de nas btsas pa'i dus su rang gi lus sems bral ba la thug pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung yang bzod par byas te/ skyes nas brda don mi shes shing ci yang mi nus pa rol kha'i 'bu lta bur yod pa la/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/

byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ (337)zas zhim pa lces bsnyod/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ sor mo bcu'i kha la blangs/ zas gos la sogs pa ci nus su sbyar/ gnod pa mtha' dag bsal/ cher skyes nas rang gi srog dang bsdos pa'i nor gces pa byin/ 'bri klog la sogs la bslab bya'i rigs kun bslab/ mdor na phan btags shing gnod pa kun las bskyabs pa la sogs drin ci yod bsam mo// gsum pa byams pa bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon zla bas/ 'gro la phan pa nyer bsgrub pa// byams pa chen po zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ byams pa'i ngo bo// sems can rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bsam pa ni/ byams pa'i blo yin pas/ drin can gyi ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya'o snyam pa sems bskyed dang 'brel ba dang*/ bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba dang*/ bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba ste/ de ltar ma g.yengs par bsgoms shing tshig tu'ang brjod do// de ltar rtsa ba'i ma la mar shes shing drin dran nas byams pa bsgom pa ltar/ bar ma dang*/ dgra dang sems can thams cad la kha spos te bsgom mo// de ltar byams pa bsgom pas legs par 'byongs par na/ de'i stobs kyis snying rje skye ba yin te/ de skad du/ snying rje'i chub byams pa ste/ de sdug bsngal las yang dag skyes zhes gsungs pas/ des na snying rje bsgom pa la/ snying rje'i ngo bo ni/ slob dpon zla bas/ sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa// snying rje chen po zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ yul gyi sdug bsngal mthong na mi bzod cing de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i blo yin la/ de yang gnyen la bsgom pa/ dgra gnyen bar ma la bsgom pa/ dgra la bsgom pa/ sems can thams cad la bsgom pa'o// (338)dang po la gsum las/ mar shes pa dang*/ drin dran pa/

byams pa bsgom pa'i skabs ltar bya// snying rje bsgom pa ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma lta bu gson nam shi yang rung ste/ de'i rnam pa mdun tu gsal bar dmigs la/ bdag gi drin can gyi ma 'di sdug bsngal dang ldan bde ba dang bral 'dug pa snying re rje na/ 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral dgos pa la/ ma rang gi gnas lugs la bltas pas/ sdug bsngal de dang de'i rgyu dang ldan/ de'i longs spyod can tu 'dug pa snying re rje// sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dang bral bar bya'o snyam pa sems bskyed dang 'brel ba sogs byams pa bsgom pa'i skabs ltar bya zhing bsgom/ de nas yang bar ma dang*/ dgra dang sems thams cad kyi bar re re nas kha spos la snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa skyes skyes bsgom mo// de ltar snying rje skyes pa dang*/ de'i stobs kyis byang chub kyi sems skye ba yin te/ de skad du/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod// rtag tu sems can phan par sems/ ces gsungs pas/ des na de'i mjug tu kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa ni/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces pa ltar yul nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba ci yod pa thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig /bdag gis dge ba dang bde ba dang legs pa ci yod pa thams cad sems can thams cad kyis thob par gyur cig /ces tshig tu brjod cing yid kyi'ang zhe thag pa nas bsgom mo// bzhi pa de dag gis spyod pa la bslab pa ni/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gzhan la gnod pa spong zhing phan pa ci nus bsgrub pa'o/ khyad par du'ang rang smin par byed pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis (339)gzhan smin pa sogs rgyas par nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo dang*/

bslab pa kun las btus dang*/ spyod 'jug dang rgyal po la gtam du bya ba rin po che'i phreng ba las 'byung ba ltar nyams su blang gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ zhes pa'i don/ kun rdzob byang sems legs par skyes kyang*/ bden 'dzin dang bcas na rtag chad kyi mthar lhung zhing grol bar mi 'gyur bas/ des na dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por zhi lhag gnyis bsgom dgos te/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs skyon rnams 'joms par shes byas nas// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// zhes gsungs so// de la gsum/ zhi gnas bsgom pa/ lhag mthong bsgom pa/ zung 'brel tu bsgom pa'o// dang po ni// gnas dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing 'tshe ba med la/ skye bo'i rgyu 'grul dang*/ dgra'i gtsor glag sogs bsam gtan gyi tsher ma med par stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ thun thams cad kyi sngon tu 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag /lce rtse rkan la cung zad sbyar/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mig 'byed 'dzum ran par byas la bsgom/ de'ang mgon po byams pas/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas// sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong brjod/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gi dmigs rten rde'u nag po la sogs pa gang yin pa gcig gi steng du sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa zhi gnas yin la/ gnas brtan byang bzang gis/ (340)ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs nas bsgom par bshad cing*/ de dang sngar rde'u lta bu la dmigs nas bsgom pa gnyis las/ sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i thabs su khyad par med kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs pas sangs rgyas rjes su dran par 'gro zhing*/

bsod nams che bas de'i dbang du byas nas/ mdun tu rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu phyag g.yas pa sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsgoms la/ de'i sku dang khyad par smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu la dmigs shing bsgom mo// yang na 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ gdan sogs sngar dang 'dra ba la dmigs nas bsgom kyang chog gsung ngo*// de ltar lhag mthong gi sngon tu zhi gnas bsgo ba ni// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya ni/ zhes pa'i don yin no// zhi gnas la legs par goms shing dmigs rten gang rung gi steng du/ lo zla mang po'i bar sems gnas nus pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ de gcig pus mi chog gi nyon mongs pa drung nas 'byin par byed pa'i gnyen por lhag mthong bsgom dgos shing*/ de'ang so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis phyi nang gi chos kyi gnas lugs la dpyad nas/ yod med rtag chad la sogs pa mtha' dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de lhag mthong yin zhing*/ sngar bshad pa'i zhi gnas de sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i thabs yin la/ phyis lhag mthong gis mthong ba'i don la zhi gnas kyis rtse gcig tu bzhag dgos pas/ gnyis pa lhag mthong bsgom pa la gsum/ yul snang sems kyis byas par bsgrub pa/ sems sgyu mar bsgrub pa/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub (341)pa'o// dang po ni/ yul gyi snang ba sna tshogs rta dang glang po dang*/ skyes pa pho mo dang*/ rtsig pa dang*/ bum pa dang*/ snam bu la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rgyu med dam/ phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pas byas pa'am// 'byung bzhi dang rdul phran gyis byas pa'am// sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa byas pa sogs ma yin gyi/ thog ma med pa nas rang gi sems la de dang de'i bag chags bzhag pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin/

'di thams cad kyi byed pa po sems yin/ sems las gzhan pa'i de'i byed pa po med snyam du bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed po dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ci bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis// zhes gsungs pa ltar sngar bshad pa'i yul sna tshogs pa de yang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin te/ dper na/ rmi lam du bde ba dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar rmis kyang*/ sad pa na mi bden par kun gyis shes pa bzhin no// des na kun rdzob tsam du snang ba 'di/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu yin snyam du nges shes skyes skyes su bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ de ltar yul rgyu ma lta bu sna tshogs su snang ba de yang kun rdzob tsam du snang bas snang ba mi 'gog cing dpyad na don dam par grub pa skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam du yang med snyam du bsgom mo// gsum pa zung 'brel du bsgom pa ni// yul snang sems kyis byas par bsgrub pa la sogs pa rim bzhin gtan la phab nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid du rtogs shing nges par byas nas/ de ltar rtogs mkhan gyi blo dang*/ yul gyi gnas lugs dbyer med pa chu la chu'am/ mar khu la mar khu thim pa ltar ro gcig tu gyur (342)pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de bsgom mo// 'di lta bu'i rgyun bsgom par byas pas goms pa dang*// de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la stong pa nyid kyis drangs pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje sogs skye zhing dngos por 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa log ste/ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ba zhes bya ba/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi go 'phang mngon tu 'gyur ba yin no// gsum pa rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ thun thams cad kyi mjug tu'ang bya zhing*/

de'ang 'di ltar bsngo rgyu bdag gis ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ des mtshon te bdag dang gzhan gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byas pa 'dus byas kyi phyogs su gtogs pa thams cad bsngo/ bsngo ba thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi sa yang blo yul du byas/ ched du bya ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ched du bsngo/ rnam pa rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas dgongs su gsol sngon tu 'gro bas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /zhes sogs bsngo ba mdo sde dang bstan bcos las 'byung ba gang shes bya'o/ zhes pa 'di ni lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rin po che du ma'i dbang phyug /sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla ma kun dga' legs pa'i gsung gis bskul nas/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs kyis zhal sngar char gnyis mnyan te/ bla ma de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ dge slong kun dga' legs rin gyis zin bris byas nas slar yang bla ma chos kyi rje la gzigs pa phul nas dag par byas te bkod pa'o/ slad nas lung khungs rnams gsal bar bris pa dge /dge'o// maṅga lam/1$0000110

1$0000270༄༅// blo sbyong (343)zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid yig byang sems kun dga' legs rin gyis mdzad pa'i 'chad thabs nor bu ke ta ka'i do shal ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ phul byung smon pa'i chu gter las 'khrungs stong nyid bcu drug cha shas rdzogs// snying rje'i snang cha ri dwags gzugs kyis nyer mdzes phrin las zhi bsil 'od// ga bur dog pas mtshon min bskal bzang ut+pal bshes su spro mkhas pa'i// 'jam dbyangs bla ma smra ba'i zla ba mchog der phyag gis 'dud// rgyal kun ye shes rang gzugs ral gri can// mtshan dpe dom pa'i zol gyis brtse ba cher// rgyal sras 'jug pa'i srol chen don tshan bzhir// bsdus te gdams pa'i grags dkar rna ba'i dpyid// tshul de 'char byar byas pa'i rtsod bral gzhung*// ji bzhin 'chang la nyer mkho'i mtshams sbyor 'dis// 'byung 'gyur 'chad pa'i khrir 'jogs gsar bu rnams// 'chad byed ngag gi 'dod 'jo thob phyir spel// de yang ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ded dpon byang chub sems kyis rgyud phyugs pa dag gis skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la zhen pa bzhi bral gyi lam nas rnam grol rin chen gling du dkri ba'i tshul la/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i lo rgyus khrid yig nyams dbyangs kyi tshul can/ rje sa paṇa dang nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa'i zin bris/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i khrid yig /ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i khrid yig sogs yig sna mang du bzhugs pa las/ deng song khrid yig phal cher rdo rje 'chang gi rus dbon byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' legs pa'i rin chen gyis rje bla ma'i gsung sgros zin bris su btab pa'i steng nas mdzad pa shas che bas de'i (344)tshul la/ thog mar gtsug lag khang sogs gnas yid du 'ong bar/

bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po gtso 'khor bzhugs pa'i rten gyi drung du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa la sogs la/ slob dpon rang nyid rten la kha phyogs bas phyag dang bcas te/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa sngon tu 'gro bas/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar zhes sogs spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba'i tshigs gis smon 'jug sems bskyed pa blangs pas byang sdom sor chud par byas nas/ skyabs sems sngon tu btang nas slob ma la 'bog rgyu'i dmigs rkang gang yin de thun gcig bsgoms la/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun sogs kyi bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa nyi ma rjes ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o// de nas slob ma rnams thog mar/ slob dpon gyis bdud tshar bcad pa'i sngags bdun tsam bsgrang ba'i tshe/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag byas nas gral rim bzhin 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis bskul te/ smra bsam brjod med sogs sher snying tshar gcig dang*/ bdud bzlog tshar gsum gyi mjug tu/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs brgyud 'debs zur nas 'byung ba dal bus bsgrigs 'don byas pa'i tshe/ mchod g.yog pas me tog gral mgo nas bkye/ gral gshams nas bsdus/ phyag gsum btsal la/ 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' khrid zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar nas/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma phul// spro na/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyang bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis sems can thams (345)cad 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ste skad gsang mthon pos 'di skad brjod par bya'o// 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan la don nyams su len snyam pa'i byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang*/ skyes rab las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni nye bar bzhag /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta// tshig ni bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig tu// rab tu dwangs la dri med yid// nad pas sman pa'i dag nyan bzhin// rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ nyal ba dang*/ bsnyes pa dang*/ slob dpon la gzhogs dang rgyab kyis phyogs pa la sogs pa spangs te/ tsog pu'am pus mo btsugs te gus pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pas/ ngag smra ba bcad de/ yid rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byung ba brgya lam na// mi yi lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// kyai ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa/ 'di 'dra 'jig rten na ni shin tu dkon// zhes gsungs pa ltar rkyen de dag tshogs nas chos nyan tu yod pa la dga' zhing spro ba dang bcas pas gsan dgos la/ khyad par du mdo las/ legs par nyon la rab tu yid la zungs shig /ces gsungs pa'i ldog phyogs su gyur pa/ chos kyi tshigs don la yid mi gtod par snod kha bub pa lta bu'i skyon dang*/ yid gtad kyang dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis mi 'dzin pa snod zhabs rdol ba lta bu'i skyon dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis (346)bzung yang*/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*// don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*// phyi rol rnam g.yengs nang du sdud// skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'chad pa po 'di bas kho bo rang rig dang yon tan la sogs pa du ma'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags so snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ 'chad pa po 'di la skyon gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu zhig yod do snyam pa'i ma dad pa dang*// bshad bya'i chos de la shes na snyam pa'i don gnyer gyi blo med pa dang*/

gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi dngos po la rtog dpyod dang*/ rtsed mo dang ku re la sogs pas yid g.yengs ba dang*/ dug gsum gyi rtog pa 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa byed pa sogs yid nang du sdud pa dang*/ da de dag tsam la chos kyi mtshams byas na legs te snyam pa chos nyan pa'i skyo ba ste/ dri ma drug po gang rung dang ldan pa ni/ snod dri ma can gyi skyon te snod kyi skyon gsum nges par spangs dgos/ gzhan yang dpon slob gnyis kas 'du shes drug bsten cing phar phyin drug ldan tu nyams su len dgos te/ slob dpon la sman pa/ chos nyan pa rnams nad pa/ chos la sman bzang po/ nyon mongs pa la nad drag po/ nan tan gyis bsgrub pa la nad nye bar gso ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mi bslu ba'i phyir skyes bu dam pa dang*/ thabs 'dis bde bar gshegs pa'i chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par bya'o snyam pa'i 'du shes drug dang*/ slob dpon gyis chos kyi tshig don ster ba dang*/ de'i ched du yon dbul ba la sogs pa sbyin pa/ nyan bshad kyi mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i tshul khrims/ lus ngag gi dka' spyad la mi skye ba'i bzod pa/ nyan bshad la spro ba'i btson 'grus/ chos la rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan/ tshig dang don rab tu rnam par dbye ba'i (347)shes rab ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa zhag nges par dgos pas de dag tshul bzhin tu gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ 'dir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang*/ des gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyun snyigs dus kyi thub dbang gnyis pa kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po la gnang*/ des rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug la gnang*/ des yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po la/ des thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub la/ des mkhas pa chen po spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho la/

des rje btsun ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje la/ des rang gi dbon mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po la/ des dbon byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub la/ des rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la/ des 'jam mgon gnas gsang ba la/ des dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ des rje btsun ma 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma la/ 'jam dbyangs mkhon ston ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen la gnang*/ des bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma che ge mo la gnang*/ des bdag cag la dgyes bzhin tu bka' drin chen pos gnang ba'o// zhes pas mtshon rang rang gi thob yig dang bstun nas bsgyur shes par bya'o// gnyis pa man ngag dngos la sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi zhes pa nas/ las la brtson par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dmigs pa dang po ni/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ zhes pa'i don/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i zhal snga nas/ dang po tshe 'dir ma zhen par zhes pa nas/ chos brgyad kyi bsam gtan (348)shol la zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di la ma zhen pa gcig dgos kyi zhes pa nas/ dpe'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka' snyam du bsgom mo// bzhi pa ni/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad po mtha' dag tshang ba shin tu dkon pa'i phyir rnyed par dka' ste/ dal ba brgyad ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang*// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong dang*// lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// zhes gsungs pa ltar mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang*/ bral ba zhig dgos kyi/ de la dmyal ba ni sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba dang*/ yi dwags ni sems 'tshigs pa'i rang bzhin yin pa dang*/ dud 'gro ni kun tu rmongs shing rgyud ngo tsha dang khrel med pa shas che ba dang*/ lha tshe ring po ni 'gal rkyen log lta dang mngon pa'i nga rgyal skye ba'i gnas yin pa dang*/

kla klo ni ma bag mar len pa sogs blang dor phyin ci log tu spyod cing skyes bu dam pa dang 'phrad par dka' ba dang*/ log lta can ni dge ba la mtho ris dang thar pa'i rgyur mi sems shing*/ dkon mchog dang las 'bras la sogs mi bden par 'dod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis stong pa'i 'jig rten tu skyes pa'i mi rnams la bsgrub rgyu'i dam pa'i mos med pa dang*/ lkugs pa ni lce'i dbang po la skyon zhugs pa ste/ de dag blang dor gyi rnam dbyes rmongs shing chos kyi tha snyad las 'das pa'i phyir dam pa'i chos bsgrub tu mi khom mo// des na dal ba'i rten thob pa shin tu dka' ste/ rigs drug gi 'gro ba phal mo che mi khom pa'i gnas kyi nang na 'dug pa'i phyir ro// 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa la/ rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga las/ dang po ni/ mir skyes yul gyi dbus su skyes// dbang po tshang zhing gnas la dad/ de bzhin las mtha' ma log pa/ zhes gsungs te/ mir skye bar dkon pa'i tshul ni sngar bshad zin to// (349)yul gyi dbus su skye ba'ang dkon te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis 'khor rnam bzhi gang rung bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs la yul dbus dang*/ mi bzhugs pa la mtha' 'khob tu gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'khor rnam bzhi mi bzhugs pa'i sa ni nam mkha'i khyon tsam/ bzhugs pa'i sa ni shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du snang ba'i phyir ro// dbang po tshang ba dkon te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ dbang po ma tshang ba med pa yang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas kyi chos nyan pa yang rnyed par dka'/ zhes gsungs so// gnas la dad pa'ang dkon te/ legs par gsungs pa dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la snying nas dad pa thob pa brgya zhig na re re tsam du snang ba'i phyir ro// las kyi mtha' ma log pa'ang dkon te/ mtshams med lnga rang gi byed pa dang*/ gzhan la byed du 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan gyis byas pa dga' ba bsgom pa ches mang du snang ba'i phyir ro// gzhan 'byor lnga ni/

sangs rgyas 'byor dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'brang*/ gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o// zhes gsungs te/ de'ang sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byon pa shin tu dkon te/ sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i bskal pa la sgron bskal dang*/ mi 'byon pa la mun bskal zhes bya zhing*/ da ltar gyi bskal ba 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon pas bskal pa bzang po zhes bya la/ de nas mun bskal drug cu'i rjes su yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal gcig /de nas mun bskal khri'i rjes su snyan pa chen po zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal gcig /de nas mun bskal sum brgya'i rjes su dpe skar ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal gcig ste/ de ltar na mun bskal khri sum brgya drug cu'i rigs la sgron bskal bzhi las mi 'byung zhing*/ sgron bskal gyi yang skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo yar 'phel la sangs rgyas mi 'byon par (350)gsungs pa'i phyir dus phal cher sangs rgyas mi 'byon pas 'da' ba yin no// des chos gsungs pa'ang dkon te/ gdul bya chos kyi snod du gyur pa med na sangs rgyas rnams chos mi gsung ba bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ zab zhe spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed// su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas// mi smra nags kyi nang du gnas par bya/ zhes gsungs shing thugs las chung ngur bzhugs pa la/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs dgos pa byung bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// bstan pa gnas pa'ang dkon te/ bskal bzang 'di'i yang sangs rgyas snga ma snga ma'i bstan pa rdzogs nas phyi ma phyi ma'i bstan pa ma byung gi bar la bstan pa med pa'i phyir ro// bstan pa'i rjes su bdag gzhan 'jug pa yod pa'ang dkon te/

phyi rol mu stegs byed dang bstan pa la rgyab kyi phyogs pa'i 'jig rten pa ches mang zhing*/ bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs par rlom pa phal mo che yang sde snod dang rgyud sde dang de dag dgongs 'brel tshad ldan rnams tshig gi na ya yin par bsam nas rna ba thos pa tsam yang don tu mi gnyer ba de dag gi dgongs pa mi shes pa'i blun po rnams kyis gang dran sbyang ba'i rjes su 'jug pa dang*/ de lta bu la nyan bshad sgom gsum byed pa mang zhing sde snod shes par rlom pa'i snying med rnams kyang de 'dra'i sgra grag stong gi rjes su ri bong tsal rgyug byed par snang ba'i phyir ro// gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'ang dkon te/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tsho ba'i log 'tsho can dag la mgron lan 'jal ba mang yang*/ rab tu byung ba 'du 'dzi dang khyim la mi dga' zhing bsod snyoms kyi zas la brten nas klog pa dang*/ bsam gtan phyed pa dag la bsod (351)snyoms ster ba dkon pa'i phyir ro// des na lus rten gcig gi steng du chos mtha' dag tshang ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam du dkon pas ngo bo'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka' snyam du sgom mo// gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni zhes pa nas/ myur du chos bya dgos snyam du sgom mo// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub nas rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas bzhugs/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar cung zhig ngal bso/ rnam rtog thig thol gyis skyes na de'i dbang du mi btang bar rbad chod byas nas dmigs pa la 'jug /de la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi zhes pa nas myur du chos bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges pa sogs tshar gcig bskyar// gsum pa rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na bya ste/

de'ang 'di ltar bsngo rgyu sogs nas/ mdo las 'byung ba gang shes byas la thun mtshams thams cad du'ang dngos gzhi nyams len gyi rtsi dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ skyes rabs las 'byung ba'o/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ slob dpon thog med kyis mdzad pa'i theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di la zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig la/ slob ma rnams kyis nyan 'di la zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i// bdud kyi sde dang zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i/ srid pa thams cad du yang sogs nas/ mdzod gyur cig bar mnyam du mdzad nas grol lo/ ༈ /nyin (352)gnyis pa la gzhan 'dra/'o/ nam mkha' dang zhes pa nas myur du chos bya dgos snyam du bsgom mo zhes pa'i bar kha sang bzhin bskyar/ des tshe 'di la zhen pa spongs bas ngan song du mi ltung zhing blo chos su 'gro bar byed pa'i khrid kyi rim pa rnams song nas/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsal du 'bul ba la/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ zhes pa'i don/ rje btsun rin po ches mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub pa la/ sogs nas/ zhen pa byed rnams the le lo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum 'khor bar zhen na/ chos byas kyang zhes pa nas/ bskor ba byed par bsams te 'gro ba lta bu'o// zhes pa'i bar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas bzhugs/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar du cung zhig ngal bso/ rnam rtog zhig thol gyis skyes na de'i dbang du mi gtong bar rbad chod byas nas dmigs pa la 'jug /de la'ang sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i dmigs rkang dang po yan chad phul zin/

gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba la zhen na sogs gong bzhin bskyar/ slar yang sogs nas tshar gcig bskyar/ gsum pa rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa sogs nyin dang po dang 'dra'o// nyin gsum pa la/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i zhes pa nas/ lo rgyus dang gdams ngag dngos gnyis so zhes pa'i bar 'dra/ de la lo rgyus dang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i dmigs khrid dang po yan chad legs par phul zin/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba la zhen na zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba lta bu'o// des khams gsum la (353)zhen pa spangs pas 'khor ba mi 'khyams pa dang*/ chos lam tu 'gro bar byed pa'i khrid kyi rim pa rnams song nas/ da de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ gsum pa ni/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ zhes pa'i don/ rje btsun rin po ches/ zhen pa bral na mya ngan 'das/ sogs nas/ sangs rgyas shog zhes gsungs pa'i don/ sngar bshad pa ltar 'khor ba mtha' dag zhes pa nas/ nyams su blang gsungs so// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i slad du lan gcig bskyar na do nub rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyis chos dang ldan pas bzhugs/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song bar du cung zhig ngal bso// rnam rtog zhig skyes na de'i dbang du mi btang ba rbad chod byas nas dmigs pa la 'jug /de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu btang nas/ dngos gzhi la bzhi yod pa'i gsum pa ni/ bdag don la zhen na zhes pa nas/ nyams su blang gsungs so zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges pa sogs nas tshar gcig bskyar mthar/ gsum pa rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab sogs man chad 'dra'o// nyin bzhi pa la/ 'o/ nam mkha' sogs nas/ lo rgyus dang gdams ngag dngos la gnyis so// de la lo rgyus nas dngos gzhi'i dmigs khrid gnyis pa yan chad phul zin/ gsum pa ni/ bdag don la zhen na zhes pa nas/

nyams su blang gsungs so bar gong bzhin/ des bdag don la zhen pa spangs pas nyan rang du mi gol ba dang*/ lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba byed pa'i khrid kyi rim pa rnams song nas/ da de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ (354)bzhi pa ni/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ zhes pa'i don/ rje btsun rin po ches/ bdag ji ltar 'dug kyang zhes pa nas/ gang dgar zhog ces gsungs pa ltar/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems legs par skyes kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ go 'phang mngon tu 'gyur ba yin no// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos ldan pas bzhugs/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar cung zhig ngal bso// rnam rtog zhig thol gyis skyes na de'i dbang du mi btang ba rbad chod byas nas dmigs pa la 'jug /de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu btang nas/ dngos gzhi la bzhi yod pa'i/ bzhi pa ni/ 'dzin pa byung na zhes pa nas/ go 'phang mngon tu 'gyur ba yin no bar gong bzhin bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges pa sogs nas tshar gcig bskyar/ yang de 'dra ba tshar gcig ste tshar bzhi song ba na/ gsum pa rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na bya ste/ de'ang 'di ltar bsngo rgyu sogs nas/ mdo las 'byung ba gang shes byas la thun mtshams thams cad du'ang dngos gzhi nyams len gyi rtsi dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// des dngos po dang mtshan ma la zhen pa spangs pas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs/ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar byed pa'i khrid kyi rim pa rnams song zin te/ mdor na theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thams cad kyi snying po// pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa/

mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal lung zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag zab mo// bdag cag gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo'i zhal snga nas ji ltar thob pa (355)bzhin phul grub pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang*/ thog mar 'bad rtsol drag po'i sgo nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten nas thugs rgyud la nyams myong khyad par can re 'khrungs nges shes pa mdzad nas/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams gdams pa zab mos rjes su 'dzin pa la sogs pa bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad 'tshal/ khrid yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i gtong rag tu maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rigs phul la/ de ltar rang re rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i chos la 'chad nyan tshul bzhin tu byas pa la bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa de dag bar ma dor chud mi za ba'i phyir 'khor gsum rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas 'debs dgos pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas zhwa phud la/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis sogs mchod bsngo dang*/ spyi bsngo rgyas par byas la grol lo// slar smras pa/ e ma gsung rab rgya mtsho'i brjod bya'i bcud// sngon byon thub pa rnams kyis legs myongs shing*// bde gshegs rigs can kun la sbyin 'os pa// bden gnyis byang chub sems las gzhan du ci// de phyir 'jam dbyangs zhal lung bsam 'phel dbang*// mdo sngags ma 'dres 'chad tshul gos lhub rtser// bkod pas mun sprul smra rnams dogs bral zhing*// mkhas kun dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs la gzhol/ i dam las byung rab dkar dge ba des/ u da ga bzhin 'gro khams sbyangs byas nas// e waṃ gling gzhir smos pa thub pa'i chos// o da nam bzhin 'bad med spyod gyur cig /zhes zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid 'chad thabs rang bzos gzhung lugs rnyog pa bgrungs pa'i ke ta ka (356)zhes bya ba 'di ni/

slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs kyi chos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang*/ ngor chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstan pa'i chos 'byung sogs la legs par dpyad de/ dmigs med thugs rje'i gter chen chos kyi rgyal po e waṃ thar rtse mkhan chen yab sras gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin spyod cing chos bzhin tu 'doms pa mang po'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng spyi bor bkod pa'i bya bral pa 'khyams po ngag dbang legs grub kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan tu bris pa'o// maṅga la shrī dza la dzam+bu dwi pa maṇ+ḍan+tu/ 1$0000110
